title: Araliadiol Protects Human Keratinocytes From Oxidative Stress, DNA Damage, and Apoptosis via Activation of Antioxidant Signaling.
authors: Piao, Zhenyan; Yoo, Dae Sung; Park, Sang Hee; Kim, Dong Seon; Yoon, Si Eun; Yoon, Ji Hye; Lee, Jongsung; Kim, Ji Hye; Cho, Jae Youl
one_liner_zh: 研究天然化合物Araliadiol对皮肤角质形成细胞的抗氧化保护作用，涉及Nrf2/AP-1信号通路，但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Araliadiol, a triterpenoid compound isolated from Centella asiatica, exhibits diverse biological activities, including anti-cancer, neuroprotective, and hair growth-promoting properties. However, its protective effects against skin damage caused by environmental pollutants, such as urban particulate matter (UPM), remain unexplored. Given the critical role of oxidative stress in UPM-induced cellular damage, we investigated the potential of araliadiol as a dermoprotective agent and explored its underlying molecular mechanisms. METHODS: The stability of araliadiol was evaluated at various temperature conditions and solvent conditions using high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC). To explore the biological functions and signaling pathways affected by araliadiol, bioinformatic analyses including Gene Ontology (GO) enrichment, Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathway, and Monarch phenotype analysis were performed. Cellular responses to araliadiol were assessed in HaCaT and HEK293T cells by measuring reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels and transcription of antioxidant genes. Activation of nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) and activator protein-1 (AP-1) signaling pathway was further examined using quantitative polymerase chain reaction (PCR), luciferase assay, western blotting, and immunofluorescence staining. The interaction between araliadiol and mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase 7 (MKK7) was investigated through molecular docking and cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA). DNA damage and apoptosis were examined using the comet assay, gamma-H2AX staining, Annexin V/PI flow cytometry, and protein expression analysis. RESULTS: Araliadiol significantly reduced intracellular levels of ROS by upregulating key antioxidant genes, including HO-1, NQO1, TXNRD1, GCLC, and GCLM. Mechanistically, araliadiol promoted the expression and nuclear translocation of Nrf2, a master transcription factor involved in antioxidant defense. In parallel, araliadiol selectively activates the c-Jun N-terminal kinase (JNK)-AP-1 signaling cascade by directly binding to and activating MKK7, an upstream kinase involved in oxidative stress responses. Given the close association between oxidative stress, DNA damage, and apoptosis, we further investigated the protective capacity of araliadiol in this context. Araliadiol markedly attenuated UPM-induced DNA damage and apoptosis, as evidenced by reduced comet tail formation, decreased gamma-H2AX levels, a lower proportion of Annexin V-positive cells, and modulation of apoptosis-related proteins. Meanwhile, although UPM exposure induced the expression of specific antioxidant-associated genes (TXNRD and GCLC), HO-1 protein expression, and AP-1 signaling, it failed to activate Nrf2 transcriptional activity. Instead, UPM exposure resulted in elevated intracellular ROS accumulation and increased DNA damage. CONCLUSION: Our findings suggest that UPM exposure alone elicited limited stress-adaptive antioxidant responses without effective cytoprotection. In contrast, araliadiol treatment independently activated robust antioxidant and cytoprotective signaling. Moreover, under UPM exposure, araliadiol further enhanced cellular defense through the activation of the Nrf2 and JNK-AP-1 signaling pathways. These results highlight the therapeutic potential of araliadiol as a dermoprotective agent derived from Centella asiatica, particularly in mitigating pollutant-induced skin damage.
abstract_zh: 背景：Araliadiol是一种从积雪草（Centella asiatica）中分离得到的三萜类化合物，具有多种生物活性，包括抗癌、神经保护和促进毛发生长等特性。然而，其对环境污染物（如城市颗粒物（UPM））引起的皮肤损伤的保护作用尚未被探索。鉴于氧化应激在UPM诱导的细胞损伤中的关键作用，我们研究了araliadiol作为皮肤保护剂的潜力，并探讨了其潜在的分子机制。方法：使用高效液相色谱法（HPLC）评估araliadiol在不同温度条件和溶剂条件下的稳定性。为探索araliadiol影响的生物学功能和信号通路，进行了生物信息学分析，包括基因本体论（GO）富集、京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）通路和Monarch表型分析。在HaCaT和HEK293T细胞中，通过测量活性氧（ROS）水平和抗氧化基因的转录来评估细胞对araliadiol的响应。进一步使用定量聚合酶链反应（PCR）、荧光素酶报告基因检测、蛋白质印迹和免疫荧光染色检查核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）和激活蛋白-1（AP-1）信号通路的激活。通过分子对接和细胞热位移分析（CETSA）研究araliadiol与丝裂原活化蛋白激酶激酶7（MKK7）之间的相互作用。使用彗星实验、γ-H2AX染色、Annexin V/PI流式细胞术和蛋白表达分析检测DNA损伤和凋亡。结果：Araliadiol通过上调关键抗氧化基因（包括HO-1、NQO1、TXNRD1、GCLC和GCLM）显著降低细胞内ROS水平。机制上，araliadiol促进Nrf2（参与抗氧化防御的主要转录因子）的表达和核转位。同时，araliadiol通过直接结合并激活MKK7（参与氧化应激反应的上游激酶），选择性激活c-Jun N末端激酶（JNK）-AP-1信号级联。鉴于氧化应激、DNA损伤和凋亡之间的密切关联，我们进一步研究了araliadiol在此背景下的保护能力。Araliadiol显著减轻UPM诱导的DNA损伤和凋亡，表现为彗星尾形成减少、γ-H2AX水平降低、Annexin V阳性细胞比例下降以及凋亡相关蛋白的调节。同时，尽管UPM暴露诱导了特定抗氧化相关基因（TXNRD和GCLC）的表达、HO-1蛋白表达和AP-1信号传导，但未能激活Nrf2转录活性。相反，UPM暴露导致细胞内ROS积累升高和DNA损伤增加。结论：我们的研究结果表明，单独UPM暴露仅引发有限的应激适应性抗氧化反应，而缺乏有效的细胞保护。相比之下，araliadiol处理独立激活了强大的抗氧化和细胞保护信号。此外，在UPM暴露下，araliadiol通过激活Nrf2和JNK-AP-1信号通路进一步增强细胞防御。这些结果突显了araliadiol作为源自积雪草的皮肤保护剂的治疗潜力，特别是在减轻污染物诱导的皮肤损伤方面。
